description: Lists the promotions of an account: promotions[] (name, promotionId, contentLanguage, targetCountry, redemptionChannel, attributes, promotionStatus with destination statuses and itemLevelIssues) and nextPageToken.

account.description: Merchant Center account ID (digits, e.g. "123456"). Omit to use the GOOGLE_MERCHANTS_ACCOUNT_ID default.

page_size.description: Max results per page (1..250; API default 50).

page_token.description: nextPageToken from the previous response. All other parameters must be identical to the previous call.

name: list_promotions
title: List promotions
